children: Standard BioTools announced a definitive agreement to sell its Microfluidics business to ARCHIMED, with the transaction expected to close in approximately 30 days.
Entered definitive agreement to sell Microfluidics business to ARCHIMED, a healthcare-focused investment firm.
Transaction expected to close in approximately 30 days, subject to customary closing conditions.
Microfluidics business will remain part of Standard BioTools until closing to ensure operational continuity.
Company says deal furthers strategic actions for shareholders and may support growth of the business under new ownership.
